Name: X
Author: skiilaa
Description:
[center][size=6]﻿X
[/size]Extreme difficulty for Stardew Valley.

[size=5]Features[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]The player passes out at 12AM.
[/size]
[*][size=3]All item descriptions are changed to blank.[/size]
[*][size=3]Gift tastes are randomized for each person. Universal tastes are ignored.[/size]
[*][size=3]Energy and Health restores are lowered for consumable items.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1][*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
On the farm creation menu, X adds a checkbox next to the Skip Intro option. Check it, and X will be activated for that farm.

[img]https://i.gyazo.com/6de03e08b734dd76e7c6fc902dbd870e.png[/img]﻿
[/size][/center]

Tested with Stardew Valley 1.3 beta.
Should work with all versions. If not, file a bug report.
